name: Memori
tagline: Open-source, SQL-native memory engine for LLMs and AI agents.
description: An LLM-agnostic memory layer that turns agent conversations and execution into persistent, queryable state stored in standard SQL databases (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite). It adds long-term memory to any LLM app with roughly one line of code, using a dual-mode system for working and long-term recall. MemoriLabs also offers a hosted enterprise memory fabric on top of the open core.

modelSupport.notes: LLM-agnostic; bring any provider key, memory persists in your own SQL database.

insight: Open-sourced under Apache-2.0 by database startup GibsonAI in September 2025.
edge: Stores agent memory in ordinary SQL (Postgres/MySQL/SQLite) with one line of code — no separate vector database to run or pay for.
pros: Persistent memory in standard SQL databases
No vendor lock-in; data stays in your DB
cons: SQL-first design may not suit graph use cases
Self-hosting means you run the database

references.title: GibsonAI Releases Memori: An Open-Source SQL-Native Memory Engine for AI Agents
